tools_used: committed case tree (event.yaml of the companion petition)
helpful: Provisioned petition and BIO text: the BIO's vehicle argument drove most of the downward adjustment.
Per-Term salience-band table with bracketed reached rates: a clean leakage-safe anchor to pool.
Companion case discoverable in the committed tree by grepping event.yaml titles.
gaps: No statpack cut for 'response requested after waiver', the strongest signal on this docket; the band does not encode it.
No way to look up a related/companion petition in the corpus by party name or docket number (fedcourts query has no caption filter); I fell back to grep over data/cases.
The CourtListener daily rate limit is shared across cells; a per-cell budget or a cached docket mirror for SCOTUS would avoid the 429 degradation.
No hold-tracking: a 'held pending <docket>' signal, or the SG CVSG-brief status of a named petition, would directly inform this kind of cell.
notes: Petition text was flagged truncated (136 pages) so the appendix opinions below were unavailable; the argument sections were intact. QP file was cleanly cut.
